registered: 2026-10-24, before any pull request below is read
question: On public agent pull requests that name a CVE, does patch-day mode switch on, and which files would it ask about?
population: AIDev pull_request rows (data/pull_request.parquet) whose title or body matches CVE-\d{4}-\d{4,} (case-insensitive), every one, no sampling
task_text: the linked issue's title and body when the pull request links one (related_issue), else the pull request's title and body (aidev_recall.task_text)
files: the net files of the pull request's last commit (aidev_recall.net_files), from the dataset's pr_commit_details rows; a pull request with no rows is reported unreadable
claims_allowed: counts of pull requests per why_not and switched_on, and the listed files themselves; no recall, precision or 'would have caught' claim, because nobody labelled which files were wanted

sentences.some: Patch-day mode switched on for {on} of {n} public agent pull requests that name a CVE, and on those asked about {asked} files beside the version change.
sentences.none: Patch-day mode switched on for none of {n} public agent pull requests that name a CVE: {top_reason} was the most common reason.
